collection.title: Hyundai i800 2008 to 2021 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Hyundai i800 2008 - 2021 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Hook type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this i800 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
